convert_tf_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert a TensorFlow BigBird checkpoint to a PyTorch model using a config json file and save to output path
load_tf_weights_in_big_bird: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into a PyTorch BigBird model with optional TriviaQA head support
convert_bigbird_trivia_qa_to_pytorch: convert a TriviaQA TensorFlow BigBird checkpoint to PyTorch with question answering head
convert_bigbird_pretraining_to_pytorch: convert a pre-training TensorFlow BigBird checkpoint to PyTorch for masked language modeling
run_bigbird_tf_to_pytorch_cli: run the BigBird TensorFlow to PyTorch checkpoint conversion script via command line arguments
